en: Ekakanipāta, Kusanāḷivagga (The Chapter on the Reed)
“Whether equal, or even superior, or perhaps inferior, one person alone may act [thus] toward another.”
"These people would bring about ruin instead of the highest goal,
just as I did with the reed-stalks. Thus ends the first Jātaka, the Kuśanāḷi Jātaka.
